top_signals.title: Ceremony held for recipients of Japan’s Order of Culture
top_signals.summary: The government announced the names of the eight awardees, including Nobel laureate Kenso Soai and Nintendo's Shigeru Miyamoto, last month.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Strive inches closer to becoming second-largest public bitcoin holder after latest $10 million buy
top_signals.summary: Strive bought another 124 BTC, bringing it closer to becoming the second-largest public company holder of bitcoin after Strategy.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Your Mobile Carrier Stores Your Call Logs for Years
top_signals.summary: Mobile carriers can retain years of call and text metadata, exposing sensitive details about customers' relationships, locations, and daily routines if breached. Cape examines the privacy risks of long-term telecom data retention and how its mobile service reduces exposure by automatically deleting call records. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: As Japan marks 80 years of Constitution, debate continues on emergency clause
top_signals.summary: Some experts argue such a clause is needed for swift initial responses to disasters, while others worry it could lead to concentrated authority.
